title: AI-assisted Artifact Collaboration Workflow
summary: 研究 Dropbox、Conversation、Primary Agent local workspace 與 GitHub 如何組成低摩擦 Artifact Collaboration Workflow。已驗證 Conversation 圖片可由 Agent 加工並透過 Git object/blob path 建立 binary commit/branch；Dropbox 可作 private intake、preview 與小型文字 PDF reference，但 Dropbox binary 直接進 local processing workspace 仍存在 transport gap。Public evidence 採 privacy-scrub，不保存私人 storage topology。
flow: Partial: Human Drop Zone / Dropbox discovery / small text PDF fetch / Conversation image processing / Local Workspace → GitHub binary verified. Open: Dropbox → Local Workspace binary, Local Workspace → Dropbox, GitHub → Local Workspace, bidirectional end-to-end routing.
